claim: Widely available booths reproduce the full tactile experience
originalWording: Widely available booths reproduce the full tactile experience

sources.title: The Age of Spiritual Machines — Ray Kurzweil (1999)

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source on Sources for attribution limits.

strict.criterion: A widely available booth convincingly reproduces whole-body pressure, temperature, texture and wetness.
strict.rationale: Limited vibration/force feedback did not constitute the specified full tactile environment in 2019. Recent finger-scale thermal/pressure research remains materially short of an all-enveloping, all-facet consumer booth.

evidence.title: Research prototype for thermal and pressure haptics
evidence.note: Local finger-scale multimodal haptics; not whole-body, all-sensation realism. Preprint status retained.
